name: Doombringer
description: The Doombringer was a Harrower-class dreadnought equipped with the Silencer, a superlaser capable of destroying an entire fleet. During the Cold War it was Moff Valion Pyron's flagship and became part of Darth Nox's fleet.

data.name: Doombringer
data.armament: ca. 39-43 Turbolaser cannon turrets, 1 Silencer Superlaser
